name: Dana Point Harbor Shops
description: Dana Point Harbor Shops is a charming waterfront shopping destination nestled in the scenic Dana Point Harbor, offering a unique blend of coastal retail, dining, and maritime charm. This harbor-side center features specialty shops, restaurants, and galleries with stunning ocean views, creating an authentic Southern California coastal experience. Visitors can enjoy browsing boutiques, waterfront dining, and watching boats in the marina while soaking in the relaxed harbor atmosphere.
summary: A picturesque waterfront shopping center in Dana Point Harbor offering coastal retail, dining, and spectacular marina views.
